test_title: PYST 41: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the given letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : ZTW :: NHK : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : ZTW :: NHK : %

Option 1) # = UGF, % = SPR → UGF : ZTW :: NHK : SPR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/307c3277dd7f084cb1405d8e65b5a55d269c52e8040e81b481f41a6e242c7ffd.png] 

Option 2) # = UKH, % = OHY → UKH : ZTW :: NHK : OHY

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d029a67bbea9d2fc69485bf325331c7c5ae4fa02096aebd002ded4ac232f42e7.png] 

Option 3) # = UOR, % = SMP → UOR : ZTW :: NHK : SMP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9b83cb3b4cc69dd1d90cb593191e3154a799f14ffe51158e21b6c501327100b.png] 

Option 4) # = UPL, % = TYF → UPL : ZTW :: NHK : TYF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c89a63ecb5ca0b88d6aa7dd0a8605c0252c62e14ef0992e6817dfbfddbbbdd6.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
